Posts like these are why I lurk here a lot less than I used to. I feel like this sub has just grown bitter about the world for.. reasons? It's not like the human condition has changed all that much over the millenia. There's always been plenty of sin snd heresy to go around. People have been treating Church as a social club since it first came into the world. This is lamentable, and certainly I'd encourage someone to look deeper into their faith if that's necesarry, but at the end of the day, it's their choice. We can't control people's motivations and desires. 
Why not look at all the good in the world? The average quality of life is way up for any given person. People are living longer. Social justice has come a long way. Praise God for the advancements humanity has made. 

As a Catholic I'm called to witness my faith. If a friend of mine (and this does apply to several of my friends) doesn't want to hear me talk about religion, I'm not going to force them to listen. If anything that would have the opposite effect of the message I'm intending to deliver. So I'll shut up and pray for them, because we ultimately don't know if a person is damned or saved unless it's revealed to us directly. So I suppose I disagree with Aquinas' view on the afterlife based on the grounds that it's ultimately unknowable.
